name: card-magician
description: A tool for creating custom playing cards.
author: mator

scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently --handle-input -k -n dev,app -c "gray,green" "npm:dev" "neu run --disable-auto-reload -- --mode=chrome"
scripts.mobile: npm run build && concurrently --handle-input -k -n dev,app -c "gray,green" "npm:dev" "neu run --disable-auto-reload -- --mode=browser"
scripts.test: npm run build && concurrently --handle-input -k -n dev,test -c "gray,green" "npm:dev" "neu run --disable-auto-reload -- --run-tests --mode=chrome"
scripts.localize: npm run build && concurrently --handle-input -k -n dev,localize -c "gray,green" "npm:dev" "neu run --disable-auto-reload -- --localize --mode=chrome"
